profile.summary: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited manufactures and sells sugar and its by-products in India. The company operates through Sugar, Distillery, Co-generation, and Others segments. It offers molasses, bagasse, and press-mud products. In addition, the company provides industrial spirits, including ethanol and fusel oils.
